meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude会扫描项目,找出未使用的代码,并用代码引用检查确认确实未被引用。随后把删除任务分给多个并行代理,每个代理负责一批文件,独立提交,最后Claude汇总结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求清理未使用代码,说出“remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup”等触发词时,技能会启动。如果指令中带上具体文件、目录或符号名,扫描会缩小到该范围。

say.text: 请清理这个项目里的死代码。
say.note: Claude会扫描全项目并派发多个并行代理删除。

say.text: 找出未在任何地方使用的文件和导出符号并删除。
say.note: Claude会重点寻找未被引用的文件和导出项。

say.text: 请只清理 src/legacy 目录里的未使用代码。
say.note: 会把扫描范围限定在该目录,不会全库扫描。

howto.what_en: Claude finds unused code, verifies it via LSP reference checks, then delegates the deletions to parallel agents. Each agent cleans one batch and commits it, and Claude reports a final summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to clean up unused code with phrases like "remove dead code", "dead code", or "cleanup". If a file, directory, or symbol name is given, scanning is narrowed to that scope.

say_en.text: Clean up dead code in this project.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and delegate removals to parallel agents.

say_en.text: Find and remove files or exported symbols that are never referenced.
say_en.note: This searches for orphaned files and unused exports.

say_en.text: Only clean up unused code in the src/legacy directory.
say_en.note: Restricts the scan to that directory only.
